messages:
zoe_support: Support getting a spike of 5xx/504s from hosted API for a few customers, ACME reported first. Tickets piling up.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] 10:11 UTC - hosted-gateway.p95 > 2.1s, error rate 504/502 up. dashboard: https://graf.redwood/alert/9933
matt_oncall: Oncall grabbing traces now. Any deploys to gateway/batcher in last 4h?
jin_sre: No infra deploys. I'm seeing inflight_slot_util jump on gw-host-12 -> 0.96 -> 0.995. Lots of long-lived slots.
tara_runtime: Batcher backlog length increasing, per-batch assembly times are up. Looks like a few long sequence requests are monopolizing slots and blocking continuous batching.
sam_re: Can we get a sample request body from support? Need tokens, max_tokens, any streaming flags.
zoe_support: Customer pasted this example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<~12k tokens>"}],"max_tokens":8192}'
```
ash_product: That's huge. Do we soft-reject oversized requests?
tara_runtime: Gateway currently queues when runtime busy rather than rejecting. With continuous batching, longseqs occupy inflight slots and small requests queue behind them.
jin_sre: Metrics: queue_depth_by_tenant[acme-prod]=112, inflight_slots held by longseqs 33/35 on gw-host-12, kv-cache misses spike causing batcher warmup stalls.
matt_oncall: Reproduced locally: 15 concurrent long requests -> gw slot saturation -> small requests get 504 after ~7-9s.
opsbot: runbook task: throttle-tenant recommended. Command: `./opsctl throttle tenant acme-prod --rps 5` (oncall only).
matt_oncall: Throttled acme-prod to 5rps and draining affected host for low-latency tenants. Applying now.
zoe_support: Customer reports errors dropped to near-zero within 40s after throttle :thumbsup:
jin_sre: Short-term proposal: change ingress to early-reject when inflight_slot_util > 0.9 instead of queueing. Also add tenant backpressure header so clients get 429 with Retry-After.
tara_runtime: Runtime patch idea: preempt extremely long requests at batch boundaries to free slots for small requests. Also track per-request estimated token cost so gateway can prioritize.
sam_re: Suggest adding quick client-side friendly response: if content-length tokens > X then 413 with clear message to truncate or use chunked streaming.
ash_product: Product note: customers need proactive notifications when we throttle. Many opened support tickets rather than seeing Retry-After. opsbot, create a support outreach task.
opsbot: Created ticket SUP-8942 for proactive emails and runbook updates.
matt_oncall: Follow-ups: 1) add mitigation section to runbook (throttle, drain host), 2) Canary ingress early-reject change, 3) schedule postmortem with runtime/SRE + product to discuss UX.
jin_sre: Investigation saved: root cause likely interaction of long sequence cold KV-cache misses + continuous batcher waiting for min_batch_size, causing inflight_slot accounting to hold slots longer than expected.
zoe_support: Customer-facing message sent, CS confirmed acme-prod recovered. Leaving thread open until runbook changes land.
ash_product: Filing product ticket for max_sequence UX and error code semantics (413 vs 429 vs 504).
matt_oncall: marking active until canary rolled. last_message_ts 1834567920, will update after canary.
